Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim wb As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, g As Object
    Set wb = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = wb.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Range("A1:D4").Value = Application.Transpose(Application.Transpose(Array(Array(1, 3, 2, 4), Array(-1, 2, -3, 4), Array(5, 4, 3, 2), Array(2, 2, 2, 2))))
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = TypeName(g) & " " & g.Type & " " & g.SourceData & " " & g.Location.Address & " " & g.Count & " " & ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count & " " & ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Count & " " & ws.Range("A1").SparklineGroups.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\one.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 1
        Set g = ws.Range("E1:E3").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkColumn, "A1:D3")
        Tried = g.Type & " " & g.SourceData & " " & g.Location.Address & " " & g.Count & " " & g.Item(2).Location.Address & " " & g.Item(2).SourceData & " " & TypeName(g.Item(1))
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\three.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 2
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkColumnStacked100, "A1:D1")
        Tried = g.Type
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\winloss.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 3
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = g.LineWeight & " " & g.SeriesColor.Color & " " & g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor & " " & g.SeriesColor.TintAndShade & " " & g.DisplayBlanksAs & " " & g.DisplayHidden
    Case 4
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.SeriesColor.Color = RGB(255, 0, 0)
        g.LineWeight = 1.5
        Tried = g.LineWeight & " " & g.SeriesColor.Color
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\styled.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 5
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        ws.Range("E3").SparklineGroups.Add xlSparkColumn, "A2:D2"
        Tried = ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count & " " & ws.Cells.SparklineGroups(1).Location.Address & " " & ws.Cells.SparklineGroups(2).Location.Address & " " & ws.Range("E1:E3").SparklineGroups.Count & " " & ws.Range("E2").SparklineGroups.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\two.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 6
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.Delete
        Tried = ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count
    Case 7
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Clear
        Tried = ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\cleared.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 8
        Set g = ws.Range("E1:E2").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D2")
        ws.Range("E2").SparklineGroups.Clear
        Tried = ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count & " " & g.Count & " " & g.Location.Address & " " & g.SourceData
    Case 9
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        ws.Range("E1").ClearContents
        Tried = ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count
    Case 10
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        ws.Range("E1").Clear
        Tried = ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count
    Case 11
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        ws.Range("A1:D1").Clear
        Tried = ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count
    Case 12
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = g.Creator & " " & TypeName(g.Parent) & " " & TypeName(g.Application)
    Case 13
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = TypeName(g.Item(1).Parent) & " " & g.Item(1).SourceData & " " & g.Item(1).Location.Address
    Case 14
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = TypeName(ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Parent) & " " & ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Parent.Address
    Case 15
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = g.Item(2).SourceData
    Case 16
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = g.Item(0).SourceData
    Case 17
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups(2).Type
    Case 18
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.Type = xlSparkColumn
        Tried = g.Type
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\retyped.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 19
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.Type = 9
        Tried = g.Type
    Case 20
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(4, "A1:D1").Type
    Case 21
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1").SourceData
    Case 22
        Tried = ws.Range("E1:F1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D2").Location.Address
    Case 23
        Tried = ws.Range("E1:F2").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D4").Count
    Case 24
        Tried = ws.Range("E1:E4").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D4").Item(3).SourceData
    Case 25
        Tried = ws.Range("A10:D10").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D4").Item(2).SourceData
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\across.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 26
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "Sheet2!A1:D1").SourceData
    Case 27
        wb.Worksheets.Add After:=ws
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "Sheet2!A1:D1").SourceData
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\elsewhere.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 28
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "nonsense").SourceData
    Case 29
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "").SourceData
    Case 30
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "$A$1:$D$1").SourceData
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\absolute.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 31
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "a1:d1").SourceData
    Case 32
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D2").SourceData
    Case 33
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add xlSparkLine, "A2:D2"
        Tried = ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count & " " & ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups(1).SourceData
    Case 34
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").Value & "|" & IsEmpty(ws.Range("E1").Value)
    Case 35
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        ws.Range("E1").Value = 5
        Tried = ws.Range("E1").Value & " " & ws.Cells.SparklineGroups.Count
    Case 36
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.Location = ws.Range("F1")
        Tried = g.Location.Address
    Case 37
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.SourceData = "A2:D2"
        Tried = g.SourceData
    Case 38
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.Modify ws.Range("F1"), "A2:D2"
        Tried = g.Location.Address & " " & g.SourceData
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\modified.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Case 39
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.ModifySourceData "A3:D3"
        Tried = g.SourceData
    Case 40
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.ModifyLocation ws.Range("G1")
        Tried = g.Location.Address
    Case 41
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.Item(1).SourceData = "A2:D2"
        Tried = g.SourceData & " " & g.Item(1).SourceData
    Case 42
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.Item(1).ModifyLocation ws.Range("H1")
        Tried = g.Location.Address
    Case 43
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.SeriesColor.Color = vbGreen
        Tried = g.SeriesColor.Color & " " & g.SeriesColor.ThemeColor
    Case 44
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.LineWeight = 0
        Tried = g.LineWeight
    Case 45
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.LineWeight = -1
        Tried = g.LineWeight
    Case 46
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.LineWeight = 2000
        Tried = g.LineWeight
    Case 47
        Set g = ws.Range("E1").SparklineGroups.Add(xlSparkLine, "A1:D1")
        g.LineWeight = 0.75
        Tried = g.LineWeight
        wb.SaveAs folder & "\weight.xlsx", xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    End Select
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = 0 To 47
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i, folder)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
